record.paper_title: Open problems in Euclidean Ramsey Theory
record.original_question: For each positive integer r, what is the minimum Euclidean dimension n such that every partition, equivalently every r-coloring, of all points of Euclidean n-space into r parts contains the four vertices of a unit square in one part?

evidence.quote: if the points of Euclidean n-space are partitioned into r parts
the minimum value of n for which this is true depends on r is still not known

artifact.self_contained_problem: For a positive integer r, let f(r) denote the smallest non-negative integer n with the following property: for every partition of the points of Euclidean space R^n into r classes (equivalently, every r-coloring of R^n), at least one class contains four points that form the vertices of a unit square (i.e., a square whose sides have length 1). Determine f(r) as a function of r. In particular, for each r ≥ 2 establish the exact minimum dimension n = f(r) such that any r-coloring of R^n necessarily yields a monochromatic unit square.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact minimum dimension f(r) ensuring a monochromatic unit square under any r-coloring of Euclidean space is not known in general. For r = 2, it is known that 2 dimensions are insufficient while 5 (and even improvements toward smaller dimensions) are sufficient, but the exact value is still unsettled, and for r ≥ 3 the question is widely open. Recent surveys and papers on Euclidean Ramsey theory and Gallai–Ramsey variants continue to list this as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Euclidean Ramsey Theory (Graham, survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Ramsey-type results for the unit square and notes open questions on minimum dimension for r colors.
status_evidence.claim: The minimum dimension n guaranteeing a monochromatic unit square for r-colorings remains open.

status_evidence.title: Ramsey Problems for Graphs in Euclidean Spaces and Cartesian Powers
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work studying Euclidean Ramsey numbers for squares and related configurations.
status_evidence.claim: Exact values for the minimum n in the r-color unit square problem are not determined.

status_evidence.title: Euclidean Gallai-Ramsey for various configurations
status_evidence.snippet: Considers multi-color Ramsey problems for unit squares in Euclidean space.
status_evidence.claim: Multi-color versions of the unit-square Ramsey dimension problem remain unresolved.
